versions.changelog:
What changed in v2.6.0:

Added data handling notice — explicit disclosure that text is transmitted to remote API over HTTPS and immediately discarded after sanitization
Added /.well-known/x402.json discovery endpoint for autonomous x402 agent payment flow
Added /preflight endpoint with billing_model, price_per_unit, and bundle_description for buyer-agent wallet authorization
Added /policy endpoint returning SHA-256 hash of service terms for agent verification before payment
Added HEAD method support to /.well-known/x402 for agent preflight checks
Added 10 discovery aliases — /agents.txt, /mcp.json, /.well-known/agents.json, /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json and more
Added /trustboost-pii-sanitizer alias for ClawHub skill agents
Added /.well-known/glama.json for Glama marketplace indexing
Added billing_model transparency field to /preflight
Extended llms.txt with complete payment flow example and Python copy-paste code
Added AGENTS.md — Linux Foundation standard for agent interaction
Added .cursor/rules for automatic PII sanitization in Cursor workflows
Added plugin.json and manifest.json for Claude Code plugin directory
8 languages supported: EN, ES-LATAM, PT-BR, DE, JA, FR, IT, KO

TrustBoost PII Sanitizer v2.6.0 is a major update with new languages, expanded compliance, and on-chain proof features.

- Added support for French, Italian, and Korean, including country-specific PII patterns (NIR, Codice Fiscale, 주민등록번호).
- Enhanced compliance: now references EU AI Act (2026) alongside GDPR, LGPD, etc.
- All paid sanitizations are now anchored on Solana blockchain for immutable proof—verifiable via new /verify/{anchor_tx} endpoint.
- Endpoints expanded and documented, including x402 payment flow and status endpoints.
- Wallet handling clarified; agent address used solely for quota tracking.
- Updated quick-start, docs, and demo resources for clarity and auditability.

**Major update: Context-aware PII sanitization and autonomous agent features.**

- Added context-aware sanitization with 5 modes: legal, financial, medical, code, general.
- Introduced Privacy Budget per agent for configurable usage limits.
- New TrustBoost Score enables machine-to-machine (M2M) trust verification.
- API now returns the applied context and new risk category ("CLEAN" added).
- Preview endpoint allows 3 free requests per IP, no wallet required.
- Metadata updated: now at version 2.5.0, new endpoints, and feature descriptions.

- Updated version to 2.0.4.
- Updated metadata to clarify that no environment variables are required.
- Added a new wallet_security section to explicitly state that TrustBoost never requires or handles wallet private keys or signing credentials—only public wallet addresses are used for quota tracking.
- No code or functional changes; documentation and metadata improvements only.

- Added a homepage link (GitHub repository) to the skill metadata.
- Updated the version number in metadata from 2.0.1 to 2.0.2.
- No functional or API-level changes.

trustboost-pii-sanitizer v2.0.2

- Updated internal version metadata from 2.0.0 to 2.0.1.
- Added a new metadata field, `requires_env`, specifying an optional environment variable (SOLANA_WALLET_KEY) for agents needing autonomous payments.
- No other functional or user-facing changes detected.

- API endpoint and health check URLs updated from onrender.com to api.trustboost.dev.
- No other functional changes; all features, payment, and compliance details remain the same.
- Documentation and operator verification sections now reference the new API domain.

TrustBoost PII Sanitizer v2.0 brings major infrastructure and API updates:

- Migrated from Make.com to a new API endpoint powered by FastAPI, Supabase, and Render (AWS) for improved reliability.
- Per-wallet TRIAL quota: 50 free sanitizations per Solana wallet (was global).
- Audit logging now handled via Supabase PostgreSQL (never stores raw input).
- API endpoints, health checks, and documentation updated to reflect new infrastructure.
- Enhanced replay attack protection and explicit wallet-based free quota.
- Streamlined error and success responses; see updated JSON schema.

**Major update: Adds a transparency section with detailed operator and data flow disclosure.**

- Added a "Transparency Notice" with clear explanations of data flow, storage, Make.com processing, and audit trail for compliance clarity.
- Now explicitly highlights when NOT to use the skill (e.g., on-prem HIPAA, non-approved data processors, or real secrets in prod).
- Expanded payment model explanation with cautionary guidance for autonomous agent use—emphasizing quota checks and wallet key safety.
- Clearly documents operator identity, audit/compliance endpoints, and repository links for verification.
- No changes to core API functionality or integration method.

trustboost-pii-sanitizer 1.2.0 – Major upgrade with multilingual, autonomous, and privacy features.

- Adds country-specific PII detection for English, Spanish (LATAM), Portuguese, German, and Japanese texts.
- No authentication or SDK required; single POST request workflow introduced with 50 free trial uses.
- Supports privacy compliance for GDPR, LGPD, APPI, HIPAA, CCPA, DPDPA.
- Autonomous Solana-based payment and quota management with a new tx_hash system.
- Responds with sanitized text, safety score (0.0–1.0), risk category, and usage metrics.
- Enhanced documentation and code samples for agent and pipeline integration.
